sentences.text:
Anil Kumar Singhal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
on 11 April, 2023

Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
Bench: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 40
Case :- Writ - C No. - 9796 of 2023
Petitioner :- Anil Kumar Singhal And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Tanmay Sadh,Ramesh Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mahesh Narain Singh,Ravi Prakash Pandey
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Suresh Singh, learned Additional Chief Standing
Counsel for the State respondents and Shri M.N. Singh, learned counsel for Vice Chairman,
Ghaziabad Development Authority, Ghaziabad.

By means of present writ petition, petitioners are seeking a mandamus commanding the respondents to pay the enhanced compensation to the petitioners, as has been determined by the Collector/Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition) Ghaziabad-respondent no.2 by order dated 02.05.2022 in the proceeding under Section 28-A of Land Acquisition Act 1894 (in brevity the 'Act 1894') within stipulated period.

Anil Kumar Singhal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 11 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146091975/

entities.text: Anil Kumar Singhal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In support of his submission, learned counsel for the petitioners states that the application of the petitioners have been entertained under the provision contained under Section 28-A of the Act 1894 and the name of petitioner no.1 finds place at serial no.29 and petitioner no.2 and 3 at serial no.23.
Consequently, the compensation has been enhanced by order dated 02.05.2022 fixing @ Rs.297 per square yard.

In this backdrop, he states that inspite of the said order on 02.05.2022 till date the enhanced compensation has not been disbursed in favour of petitioners and said situation has impelled the petitioners to be before this Court with the aforesaid relief.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the writ petition pending consideration.

The writ petition, on consent, is disposed of with observation that in case petitioners approach the Collector/Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition) Ghaziabad-respondent no.2 with all relevant documents within three weeks from today, their claim would be considered in the light of order dated 02.05.2022 expeditiously and in case there is no other impediment, the enhanced compensation would be paid to the petitioners at the earliest.
It is made clear that the Court has not expressed any opinion on the merit of the case.

Order Date :- 11.4.2023 A. Pandey  Anil Kumar Singhal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 11 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146091975/
